items.title: Josh Downs: Productive in team debut
items.text:
Downs secured four of five targets for 53 yards and a touchdown, fumbled once but recovered and returned three punts for 10 yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons on Sunday.

items.title: Ollie Gordon: Productive with 24 touches
items.text:
Gordon rushed 20 times for 76 and brought in four of five targets for 39 yards in the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts on Sunday.

items.title: Brock Bowers: Won't return to action Sunday
items.text:

items.title: Emmett Johnson: Stellar showing in Week 10 win
items.text:
Johnson rushed 22 times for 101 yards and brought in six of seven targets for 70 yards and two touchdowns in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons on Sunday.

items.title: Rashee Rice: Productive with five catches in win
items.text:
Rice brought in five of six targets for 82 yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons on Sunday.
